AccountConsentResponse.description: A consent write's outcome: whether it changed anything, and the account as it is.

AccountExportResponse.description:
Everything Hypha holds about the customer, for the person it's about: the account, their
orders, the orders' payments and the emails sent about them. Records
`customer.data_requested`, as the admin's export does.

emails.description: The emails sent about the orders.

exported_at.description: When the export was made, RFC 3339 in UTC.

AccountResponse.description: The signed-in customer, as they see themselves.

created_at.description: When the account was created, RFC 3339 in UTC.

custom_fields.description:
The custom field values the merchant shows the account holder (`access.storefront:
read`), `{"custom.tier": "gold", …}`.

email.description: The address they sign in with; it can't be changed from the account in v1.

email_marketing.description: Consent to marketing by email; `PUT /storefront/account/marketing/email` changes it.

erasure_due_at.description:
When a requested erasure runs, RFC 3339 in UTC; absent without a request. `DELETE
/storefront/account/erasure` cancels it until then.

sms_marketing.description: Consent to marketing by SMS; needs a phone.

code.description: As the buyer typed it: it's trimmed and compared ignoring case.

AddressRequest.description:
An address for the address book. Sending it again (PUT) replaces it whole,
including whether it is a default.

redacted.description:
Personal fields left out for this caller: an API key or app without the matching
`customer_data:*` scope. They are absent from the object then, whatever the schema
says. Never sent to staff or storefronts.

AssetKindDto.description:
`AssetKind` on the wire.

Known values: `image`, `video`, `file`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

CartDiscountCodeResponse.description:
Where a code the cart holds stands, for a UCP-style message pointing at
`$.discount_codes[i]`.

oneOf.description: For `blocked_by_other`: a discount applied instead.
For `minimum_not_met`: what's missing.

state.description:
`applied`; `not_eligible` (see `condition`); `minimum_not_met` (see `needed`);
`no_matching_items`; `blocked_by_other` (a better combination left it out, see
`discount`); `limit_reached`; `not_available_in_market`; `expired` (its end date
passed); `invalid` (the code or its discount is gone, deactivated, a draft or not
started). More may be added: treat an unknown one as not applied.

CartDiscountResponse.description: A discount applied to the cart: one reward of it.

amount.description: What it took off in all.

code.description: The code it came by, normalised; `null` for an automatic discount.

summary.description: One sentence from its data, amounts in the cart's market.

title.description: The discount's title, shown to buyers.

CartPaymentMethodResponse.description: A payment method as a storefront lists it for a cart.

instructions.description: Shown with the choice and after checkout; `null` for none.

provider.description:
`manual` or an app's key: what the storefront shows after choosing (instructions,
or the app's widget).

items.description: Enabled, offered in the cart's market and channel, in the order to show them.

amount.description: What it collects: the cart's total.

oneOf.description:
The provider's card form (`client_widget`: mount its element with these props on
the checkout, and check out on its `hypha:payment-confirmed`) or page
(`redirect`). `null` when the provider couldn't start (`payment_error`).

payment.description: The payment (`pay_…`): what the provider's reports name.

oneOf.description:
Why the provider couldn't start (an app that's down: `app_unavailable`): start
again. `null` otherwise.

currency.description: The currency of every amount in the cart.

discount_codes.description:
Each code the cart holds, in the order entered, with where it stands. A code that
doesn't apply now is kept: it applies once the cart qualifies.

discount_total.description: Everything they took off: already out of `subtotal` and `shipping_total`.

discounts.description:
The discounts applied, one per reward: product ones first, then order, then
shipping. Lines and shipping name them by their index here.

oneOf.description: Who to contact about the order; required at checkout.

fully_available.description: False when any line is unavailable; checkout should refuse such a cart.

market.description: Picked from the country when the cart was created; it sets the currency.

marketing_opt_in.description:
Whether the buyer ticked "Email me with news and offers" (`PUT …/marketing`):
checkout records the consent then.

oneOf.description: The order this cart was checked out as; `null` while it can still change.

How the buyer chose to pay (`PUT …/payment-method`); checkout requires one when
there's something to pay.

redacted.description:
Personal fields left out for this caller: an API key or app without the matching
`customer_data:*` scope. They are absent from the object then, whatever the schema
says. Never sent to staff or storefronts.

oneOf.description: Where it ships: in the cart's country. Required at checkout when something ships.

shipping_groups.description:
The groups of lines that ship together, each needing a chosen option before
checkout; empty when nothing ships.

shipping_ready.description: Whether every group has an option priced now (checkout requires it).

shipping_total.description:
The chosen shipping, priced now, after shipping discounts; zero until chosen. Part
of `total`.

subtotal.description:
Sum of the available lines' totals, after discounts. All totals count available
lines only.

tax_total.description:
Tax on the available lines and on shipping: part of `subtotal` and
`shipping_total` if `taxes_included`, else on top.

taxes_included.description: Whether line prices include tax (set on the market).

CategoryRef.description: A category next to it in the tree: an ancestor or a child.

oneOf.description:
The total the buyer saw; if the cart now costs something else, checkout fails
with `total_changed` (409) instead of placing a different order.

return_url.description:
Where a payment provider's page sends the buyer back (a redirect), passed to the
payment's app.

oneOf.description:
For cash on delivery and bank transfer, the instructions (quote the order number
as the reference). `null` when there was nothing to pay, for a payment made
online (before the order), or when a manual provider couldn't start
(`payment_error` says why).
Why a manual method's payment couldn't start. `null` otherwise.

CheckoutResponse.description: What checkout answers: the placed order and what the shopper must do next to pay.

consented_at.description: When the customer last said so, RFC 3339 in UTC; absent while never asked.

source.description:
Where it came from: `checkout`, `storefront`, `admin`, `import`, `system`, or
`app:<appid_…>`; absent while never asked.

country.description: Where the cart ships to; picks the market and the tax rates.

Currency.description: An ISO 4217 currency code. Funds, precious metals and test codes (XDR, XAU, XXX) aren't accepted.

CustomFieldChoice.description:
A `choice` field's choice: the key is what's stored, filtered and faceted (it can't
change); the label is for people.

code.description: The six digits from the email.

expires_at.description: When the session ends unused; every use within pushes it out again.

token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` beside `X-Publishable-Key`. Shown only now.

DiscountAllocationDto.description: How an amount off is spread over the items it reaches.

oneOf.description: Off every unit (items only).
Once, split over the items (or the order, or shipping) in proportion.
Off each of the cheapest `units` units (items only).

DiscountClassDto.description:
What a reward reduces, for combining: `product` (item lines), `order` (the subtotal
after product discounts), `shipping`.

Known values: `product`, `order`, `shipping`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

DiscountItemsDto.description:
Which items: all, or listed products, variants or categories (a category reaches the
products in it and in every category below it).

DiscountShareResponse.description: Part of a discount on a line or a shipping group.

application.description: Its index in the cart's (or order's) `discounts`.

units.description: The units it covered, for a buy X get Y discount; absent otherwise.

DiscountTargetDto.description:
What a reward reduces: items (its class is `product`), the subtotal (`order`), or
shipping (`shipping`, at most `max_amount` off when given).

oneOf.description: 1 to 10000 basis points: 1000 is 10%, 10000 everything (free).
An amount per market; `allocation` defaults to `across`.

Items only: each unit costs this much in the market, when that's lower than its
price (0 makes them free).

ElementExtension.description: A web component an app adds to a storefront (`docs/apps/elements.md`).

module.description:
The ES module that defines it: an absolute URL (`https://`, or `http://localhost`
in development). List its origin in the storefront's `script-src`.

Email.description: An email address; stored trimmed and lowercased, so responses show it that way.

Error.description: Every error body, for the OpenAPI documents. `ApiError` serializes as this shape.

code.description: Stable snake_case code: what clients match on.

details.description: Data a client acts on, for the codes that have any (see each operation).

key.description:
As `filter` takes it: `option.color`, `vendor`, `product_type`, `tag`, `on_sale`
(values `true` and `false`), or `field.<namespace>.<key>` for a custom field
(`field.custom.material`).

label.description: The merchant's label, if they set one.

values.description: Most results first, then by value; at most 100.

count.description: Results (as grouped) with this value, ignoring this facet's own filter.

label.description:
What to show for it: a `choice` field's label, "Yes" or "No" for a `boolean` field;
`null` for every other facet, whose value is its own label.

value.description:
As `filter` takes it: a `choice` field's value is its key, a `boolean` field's
`true` or `false`.

FinancialStatusDto.description:
`FinancialStatus` on the wire. A DTO of its own, so the domain enum carries no serde and
renaming a variant can't silently change the API. Derived from the order's payments:
manual payments use `pending`, `paid` and `voided`; the rest come with providers that
move money so.

Known values: `pending`, `authorized`, `partially_paid`, `paid`, `partially_refunded`, `refunded`, `voided`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

FulfillmentStatusDto.description:
`FulfillmentStatus` on the wire.

Known values: `unfulfilled`, `partially_fulfilled`, `fulfilled`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

offers.description: What the buyer can pick, in the store's order, priced now.

unavailable.description:
Options of the zone not offered right now, and why: for diagnostics, never shown
as choices.

Language.description: A BCP 47 language tag: a language, then optionally a script, region and variants (`en`, `en-GB`, `sr-Latn`). Responses show it in canonical case.

available_quantity.description:
How many of the variant can be bought now, so a quantity input can stop there:
`null` when there's no limit (stock isn't tracked, or it sells past zero).

handle.description:
The product's handle, to link to its page; `null` when the product is gone or the
cart is checked out.

oneOf.description:
The variant's image, else the product's first media item; `null` without one,
once checked out, or where the deployment has no file storage.

product_title.description:
The product's title now; `null` only when the product or variant is gone, so an
unavailable line still says what it was.

variant_title.description: The variant's option values ("M / Blue"); `null` for a product without options.

oneOf.description:
What `unit_price` is shown against, struck through: only ever above it; `null`
for none.

discounts.description: What discounts took off the line.

oneOf.description: `null` when the cart's country has no tax rates.

total.description: What the buyer pays for the line: `subtotal` less the discounts. Tax is on this.

sent.description:
Always `true`: the route answers the same whatever the email, so it tells nobody
who is a customer. The email goes out only to an address that can take one.

Money.description: An amount of money in one currency.

amount.description: In minor units (1050 is 10.50). At most 2^53 - 1 either way, so every amount is exact in JSON.

currency.description: An ISO 4217 currency code. Funds, precious metals and test codes (XDR, XAU, XXX) aren't accepted.

NeededResponse.description: What's missing for a minimum: one of the two.

oneOf.description: This much more of the qualifying items.

NextActionResponse.description: What the shopper must do next to pay.

oneOf.description:
Nothing online: show the instructions (cash on delivery, bank transfer). Empty
when the method has none.

Mount the payment app's storefront element (a custom element, loaded from
`GET /storefront/app-extensions?target=checkout.payment`) with these properties
(a card form's client secret), and wait for its `hypha:payment-confirmed` event.
Send the shopper to the provider's page.

NotificationResponse.description:
One email's record. Bodies aren't returned (they're kept only until it's sent): `POST
/admin/notification-templates/{key}/preview` with the `order` shows what it looks
like now.

error.description: Why the last attempt failed, or why it was skipped.

oneOf.description: The event it answered; `null` for resends and staff account emails.

next_attempt_at.description: When a queued message is next tried.

note.description:
How it was made, when staff should know: "sent with the default template: …"
when the store's template didn't render on this order.

provider_message_id.description: The provider's ID for it, when it gives one.

redacted.description:
Personal fields left out for this caller: an API key or app without the matching
`customer_data:*` scope. They are absent from the object then, whatever the schema
says. Never sent to staff or storefronts.

NotificationStatus.description:
Where a message is.

Known values: `queued`, `sending`, `sent`, `failed`, `skipped`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

NotificationTemplateKey.description:
One of the store's templates. The names are stable.

Known values: `layout`, `order_confirmation`, `order_shipped`, `order_tracking_updated`, `order_cancelled`, `staff_new_order`, `staff_invite`, `staff_password_reset`, `customer_login_code`, `customer_erasure_requested`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

amount.description: Before tax if the market's prices exclude it, and before shipping discounts.

amount_after_discounts.description: What it comes to after the shipping discounts the cart has now (0: free).

OrderDiscountResponse.description: A discount as it applied to an order.

amount.description: What it took off in all.

code.description: The code it came by, normalised; `null` for an automatic discount.

OrderSummaryPage.description: A page of a list, newest first.

has_more.description: Whether there are more after these.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page. Opaque: don't parse it.

OrderSummaryResponse.description: An order in a list: what a table of orders shows, without lines.

cancelled_at.description: When it was cancelled, RFC 3339 in UTC; `null` if it wasn't.

channel.description: The sales channel it was placed through.

custom_fields.description: The custom field values `?custom_fields=` asked for; absent without it.

item_count.description: How many items, adding up line quantities.

redacted.description:
Personal fields left out for this caller: an API key or app without the matching
`customer_data:*` scope. They are absent from the object then, whatever the schema
says. Never sent to staff or storefronts.

OwnerTypeDto.description:
The kinds of record fields belong to.

Known values: `product`, `variant`, `category`, `customer`, `order`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

PaymentResponse.description: A payment as the admin sees it on an order, and alone (`GET /admin/payments/{id}`).

attempt.description:
The provider's attempt the payment collects through (a Stripe PaymentIntent), for a
provider whose IDs name attempts: what reports naming another are refused for
(`payment_reference_mismatch`). Set by a report naming it (an app's) or by the
start of a provider built into the API (a spore's). Unlike `reference`, staff's
text or a capture's own ID never replace it. Null: none yet, and reports aren't
checked.

oneOf.description: The cart it was started for; `null` for money staff recorded by hand.

created_at.description: When it was created, RFC 3339 in UTC.

instructions.description: The method's instructions at checkout, as the shopper was shown them.

oneOf.description:
The method it was made with; `null` for money staff recorded on an order placed
without one.

method_name.description: The method's name when the payment was made.

oneOf.description:
The order it collects for; `null` while it's a cart's, before checkout placed the
order.

paid_at.description: When the money was collected, RFC 3339 in UTC.

provider.description: `manual`, or the key of the app that collects it.

reference.description: The provider's ID, or for manual payments what staff typed (a bank reference).

updated_at.description: When it last changed, RFC 3339 in UTC.

voided_at.description: When it was voided, RFC 3339 in UTC.

PaymentStatusDto.description:
`PaymentStatus` on the wire.

Known values: `pending`, `authorized`, `processing`, `paid`, `failed`, `voided`, `partially_refunded`, `refunded`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

access_token.description:
Lets whoever holds it read this order: keep it with the buyer (a cookie, the
confirmation email's link), never in a public place. The same for every read.

oneOf.description:
How the buyer pays: the order's newest payment; `null` when there was nothing to
pay.

PlacedOrderResponse.description:
A storefront's view of an order it placed: the order with its access token, the key to
reading it again (`GET /storefront/orders/{id}?token=`).

PlacedPaymentResponse.description:
What a storefront shows of an order's payment: how the shopper chose to pay, where
it is, and what they were told to do.

instructions.description: What the shopper was told at checkout (bank details); `null` for none.

method_name.description:
The method's name when the order was placed; `null` for a payment staff
recorded on an order placed without one.

PostalAddressRequest.description:
Sent: checked by `Address::new` (last name, first line and city required; text is
trimmed, at most 255 characters per field).

redacted.description:
Personal fields left out for this caller: an API key or app without the matching
`customer_data:*` scope. They are absent from the object then, whatever the schema
says. Never sent to staff or storefronts.

PriceBreakDto.description: From `min_quantity` of the variant in one cart line, each costs `price`.

ProductMediaResponse.description:
One item of a product's media list: what a page needs to render it. The asset's own
route has the rest.

kind.description:
`image` or `video` today. More kinds (3D models) will come: show the ones you
know and skip the others.

thumbnail_url.description:
Images: a version at most 400 pixels wide when the media URLs can resize, else
the original. `null` for videos.

url.description:
The file. Public, so it doesn't expire when served from the media URL; without
one (local development) it is signed and works for `media.download_expires` (15
minutes by default).

ProxyExtension.description: An app with a storefront proxy (`/storefront/apps/{app}/proxy/…`).

SearchHitResponse.description:
One result: a listing, a product or a variant (the request's `group`), shown by
its best match.

available.description: Whether the variant shown can be sold now.

oneOf.description:
What `price` is compared against, struck through: only ever above it; `null`
when the variant shown isn't on sale.
The variant's image, else the product's featured one.

listing.description: The listing it belongs to: the product, split by the merchant's options.

matched_variants.description: How many of the group's variants matched.

on_sale.description: Whether the variant shown has a compare-at price (the `on_sale` facet).

price.description: In the market's currency: what one of the variant shown costs.

product_price.description: Over the product's variants in this market.

variant.description: The variant shown: the best match of its group.

variant_title.description: "M / Blue"; `null` for a product without options.

max.description: Equal to `min` when every price is the same.

facets.description: The facets the merchant shows (or the defaults), counted over these results.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last. Opaque.

oneOf.description:
The lowest and highest price among the results, ignoring `price_min` and
`price_max` (for a price slider); `null` when nothing matches.

amount.description: The option's price, before shipping discounts.

discounts.description: What shipping discounts took off it.

quote_expires_at.description:
RFC 3339: for a provider's rate, when checkout asks the provider again (and may
answer `total_changed`). `null` for built-in rates, which are always current.

oneOf.description: `null` when the cart's country has no tax rates.

total.description: What the buyer pays for it: `amount` less the discounts. Tax is on this.

SetAccountConsentRequest.description:
What the customer says about marketing. The time is now and the source `storefront`:
it's the person themselves.

state.description: `subscribed` or `unsubscribed` (`pending` is for double opt-in flows an app runs).

opt_in.description: Whether the buyer wants news and offers by email.

oneOf.description:
One of the cart's `payment-methods`; `null` clears the choice. Required, `null`
included: `{}` is `422 invalid_body`, not a quiet clear.

quantity.description: At least 1; `DELETE` the line to take it out.

oneOf.description: In the cart's country; `null` clears it. A new address drops the chosen shipping.

id.description: Stable for the cart: what `PUT …/shipping/{group_id}` names.

lines.description: The available lines that ship in this group.

problem.description:
Why the chosen option can't be charged now; pick again from the offers.
`shipping_option_unavailable`, `no_price_in_currency`, `weight_unknown`, or a money
error code.

oneOf.description: The buyer's choice at its price now; `null` until chosen, or when `problem` is set.

The total the shopper sees; if the cart now costs something else, `409
total_changed` instead of collecting a different amount.

return_url.description:
Where a payment provider's page sends the shopper back (a redirect): a page that
checks the cart out (`POST /storefront/carts/{id}/checkout`).

StorefrontCategoryNode.description: A category in the storefront's tree, with its shown children.

StorefrontCategoryResponse.description: A category page's category: no admin fields, only shown children.

custom_fields.description: The custom field values the merchant shows storefronts (`access.storefront: read`).

items.description:
The shown top-level categories, each with its shown children, in order. A hidden
category is left out with everything under it.
Sorted by country code: every country some market sells to.

StorefrontCountryResponse.description: A country a market sells to, with what a storefront needs to show prices there.

minor_units.description: Digits after the decimal point of the currency (2 for EUR, 0 for JPY).

name.description: The English name; UIs show local names (`Intl.DisplayNames`).

StorefrontCustomFieldDefinitionResponse.description:
A field a storefront reads values of: what to call it, where it goes and how to show its
values. Values arrive on products', variants' and categories' `custom_fields`, keyed by
`field`.

choices.description:
A `choice` field's (or list of choices') labels, by the key values hold; `null`
for other types.

position.description: On its owner type's form, from 0: the merchant's order.

proxies.description: The apps a storefront may call through the app proxy.

oneOf.description:
What `unit_price` was shown against at checkout, struck through ("you saved");
never part of the totals. `null` without one.

discounts.description: What discounts took off the line.

fulfilled_quantity.description: How many of `quantity` standing fulfilments shipped.

oneOf.description:
The line's picture as its product is now: the variant's image, else the product's
first media item; `null` for a product gone or without media.
`null` when the country had no tax rates.

total.description: What the buyer was charged for the line, after its discounts.

variant_title.description: The variant's option values ("M / Blue"); `null` for a product without options.

StorefrontOrderResponse.description:
An order as its buyer sees it (a storefront's confirmation, the account's orders):
what `OrderResponse` holds but what only staff read: the price list a line was priced
from, a shipping rate's provider and quote, tax classes and `redacted`.

channel.description: The sales channel it was placed through.

created_at.description: When it was created, RFC 3339 in UTC.

discount_total.description: What they took off: already out of `subtotal` and `shipping_total`.

discounts.description: The discounts it got, one per reward; lines and shipping lines name them by index.

oneOf.description: `null` when nothing in the order ships.

shipping_lines.description: How each group of lines ships, as charged.

shipping_total.description: What shipping was charged, as part of `total`.

tax_total.description:
Tax on lines and shipping: part of `subtotal` and `shipping_total` if
`taxes_included`, else on top.

taxes_included.description: Whether line prices include tax (the market decided, at checkout).

updated_at.description: When it last changed, RFC 3339 in UTC.

StorefrontProductResponse.description:
A product as a storefront sees it: active products only, without admin fields. A draft
or archived product is `404 product_not_found`, the same as one that doesn't exist, so a
storefront can't tell them apart.

Prices and stock are the shopper's: with `country`, each variant carries its price in
that country's market and whether it can be bought now, priced as a cart prices it.
Without `country`, there are none: a product's base price isn't what any shopper pays.

oneOf.description: The currency of the prices; `null` when there are none.

custom_fields.description:
The custom field values the merchant shows storefronts (`access.storefront: read`),
`{"custom.material": "wool", …}`.

description.description: Sanitised HTML (scripts, styles and event attributes removed), safe to render.

media.description: In order; the first is the featured item.

options.description: What a shopper picks a variant by, in order.

prices_include_tax.description: Whether the prices include tax (the market's rule); `null` when there are none.

sold_in_country.description:
Whether `country`'s market sells the product; `null` without `country`. A
product not sold there has no prices: show it as unavailable in the country.

oneOf.description: As estimated at checkout.
`null` when the country had no tax rates.

StorefrontStoreResponse.description:
What a storefront sees of the store: what a header, footer or contact page shows. Legal
details stay in the admin until a storefront needs them.

default_language.description: The language the store's content is written in.

StorefrontTarget.description:
A storefront target.

Known values: `checkout.payment`, `product.block`, `cart.block`, `order.confirmation`. More may be added: treat an unknown one as you would an unexpected state, not as an error.

available.description:
Whether one can be bought now (in stock, or stock isn't tracked); `null` where
there's no price.

available_quantity.description:
How many can be bought now: the stock left in the market's locations, or `null`
when there's no limit (stock isn't tracked, or it sells past zero). `0` where
there's no price.

oneOf.description:
What `price` is shown against, struck through: only ever above it; `null` for
none.

custom_fields.description: The variant's own custom field values storefronts are shown.

oneOf.description: The item of the product's `media` this variant shows (an image), if any.

on_sale.description: Whether a compare-at price is shown: the variant is on sale.

oneOf.description: In `country`'s market; `null` without `country` or where it isn't sold.

price_breaks.description:
What larger cart lines cost each ("8.00 each from 10"), whichever price list wins
them: by quantity, each below `price` and the one before it. The cart prices each
line at its quantity, so a line of `min_quantity` pays that break's `price`. Empty
when buying more costs no less.

selections.description: One value per option, in the order of `options`.

title.description: Its option values ("M / Blue"); `null` for a product without options.

oneOf.description: The class whose rate applied; `null` for the country's default rate.

post.summary:
Places the order for the cart. Takes an `Idempotency-Key` header: a retry returns the
order the first request placed. The body is `{}` or `{"expected_total": …}`. Something
to pay needs a payment method chosen (`PUT …/payment-method`; 409
`payment_method_required`) and still offered (409 `payment_method_unavailable`). An
online method's money must be committed first (`POST …/payment`): none started is 409
`payment_required`, not yet committed `payment_pending` (its provider was asked; try
again shortly, or it completes when the provider reports), declined or released
`payment_failed` (start paying again). If the order can't be placed once the money is
committed (a line sold out meanwhile), the money is given back. A cart checked out
already answers with its order for an hour after it was placed (the provider's report
may have completed it), then `409 cart_completed`.

post.summary:
Starts paying for the cart before its order exists: an online method's money is
committed first, and checkout places the order once it is. Runs checkout's checks (409
`total_changed`, `payment_method_required`, …). A pending payment of the same method and
total is started again (the provider resumes it); otherwise a new one is made and the
old ones released. Refused for a manual method (409 `payment_method_offline`: check out
instead), a total of zero (409 `cart_nothing_to_pay`) and a cart whose money is
